verdict.rationale: Riveter is documented as a hosted API service. Nothing in the evidence describes an open-source, self-hostable version of its scraper. The local MCP option still requires an API key to call Riveter's service, and the GitHub repo is a client SDK, not the scraper engine, so neither counts as self-hosting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
